sections.title: All charaNams are in same tune
lyrics: charaNam 1 - jyOthirmayAkhanda roopa rAma - bhoothEsha vinuthApa - hRtha bhaktha thApa
charaNam 2 - sarava grahAdhAra bhootha rAma - gIrvANa munivandhya - sujanEshta dhAtha
charaNam 3 - yOgijana hRdhayAbja mithra rAma - bhOgishAyi ghRNA - rasa poorNa nEthra
charaNam 4 - shrI dhAntha shAntha nirvANa phaladha - vEdhAntha vEdhyA - vanisura thrANa
charaNam 5 - thvAm vinA nAnyanthra jAnE rAma - thvAm vinA kOgathir - jAnakI jAnE
charaNam 6 - dhIra bhavasAgarOTHaraNa rAma - sArathara shrI thyAga - rAja nutha charaNa
